scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL

observations.summary: Water expands as it freezes; most vulnerable pipes are outdoor hose bibs, pool and sprinkler lines, pipes in unheated spaces and along poorly insulated exterior walls; keep thermostat steady day and night, open sink cabinets, let cold water trickle, no lower than 55F when away; thaw with heating pad, hair dryer, space heater or hot towels, never an open flame; call a licensed plumber if the freeze cannot be found, reached or thawed.
observations.inference_limit: National guidance; local freeze frequency described qualitatively without statistics.
